name: Apple Game
author: João Gabriel de Campos Nassar
description: You're an apple on the run from hungry snakes across 6 ever harder phases. Grab speed potions and shields and use the side portals. Arrows to move, Z to pause.

descriptions.en: You're an apple on the run from hungry snakes across 6 ever harder phases. Grab speed potions and shields and use the side portals. Arrows to move, Z to pause.
descriptions.it: Sei una mela in fuga da serpenti affamati in 6 fasi sempre più difficili. Raccogli pozioni di velocità e scudi e sfrutta i portali ai lati. Frecce per muoverti, Z pausa.
